title: Asymptotic Equivalence Between Quasi-Grammian and Quasi-Wronskian $N$-Soliton Solutions of the Anti-Self-Dual Yang-Mills Equation
summary: Asymptotic equivalence between the quasi-Grammian and quasi-Wronskian representations of $N$-soliton solutions in the $J$-matrix formulation of the anti-self-dual Yang-Mills (ASDYM) equation is established up to a constant matrix factor. This formulation, known as the Yang equation, serves as the equation of motion of the four-dimensional Wess-Zumino-Witten (WZW$_4$) model and is equivalent to the ASDYM equation.
